test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'BREAK' is coded as '259222616'. How will 'FEVER' be coded in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae9b181f448bbd290caa72889882d6a83ee2055de592a364c84273cc21ecb5fc.png] 

**Logic: ****Every alphabet is coded as according their reverse value.**

'BREAK' is coded as '259222616'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d1f9eebe06a0feee2e6ffe3357ec9eef600565ba62582788e65eda485d76cd5.png] 

Similarly, 

'FEVER' is coded as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5c3b99343d6bdfecfb57b43f5edc16963d79863afcd2590f0e42101cad1b620.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"21225229".**
